decisions.why: 14 of the 15 products are the Dopplex handheld doppler family - D900, SD2, DMX Digital and the Ability Automatic ABI system - plus their EZ8/VP4-VP10 XS probes, the ABI and ATP kits and the Vascular Reporter / DR4 record software that accompany them; handheld doppler devices are handheld ultrasound devices. The one outlier, LymphAssist Professional, is an IPC pump the supplier files elsewhere under Vascular Treatment (already mapped wound:comp)
